topic: Minimum real-hardware YubiKey validation scenarios: the proposed scenario set for validating FIDO2/PIV behavior on physical keys, and what each scenario proves

subtopics.scope: Fresh bootc install with systemd-cryptenroll FIDO2 enrollment and initrd unlock (scenario H1): the happy-path proof that the enrolled key boots and unlocks.
seed_queries: systemd-cryptenroll fido2 LUKS2 unlock initrd boot
cryptsetup LUKS2 FIDO2 token unlock yubikey boot

subtopics.scope: LUKS2 unlock failure handling on real hardware (H2, H3): key absent falls back to passphrase, user-presence timeout fails cleanly and retries on touch.
seed_queries: LUKS2 FIDO2 fallback passphrase key absent boot
FIDO2 user presence timeout unlock failure retry systemd-cryptenroll

subtopics.scope: systemd-homed with FIDO2 on real hardware (H4, H5): homectl create with luks storage, login gated on key presence, and the recovery-key unlock path when the key is lost.
seed_queries: systemd-homed homectl fido2-device luks storage create
systemd-homed recovery key unlock luks fido2 lost

subtopics.scope: PAM login and sudo require a physical touch, not mere enumeration (H6): pam_u2f and pam_systemd_home presence semantics with key present-but-untouched vs touched.
seed_queries: pam_u2f touch required sudo ssh yubikey
pam_systemd_home fido2 authentication touch presence

subtopics.scope: SSH authentication with FIDO2 resident keys (H7): ssh-keygen ed25519-sk on the YubiKey, authorized_keys, accept with key present and reject when removed.
seed_queries: ssh-keygen ed25519-sk resident key yubikey ssh
fido2 resident credential ssh authorized_keys sk

subtopics.scope: PIV slot 9c signing for Secure Boot (H8, H9): sbsign via libykcs11 PKCS11 signs a UKI, hardware boots with SB enforcing, and a mis-signed or unsigned UKI is rejected.
seed_queries: yubikey PIV slot 9c sbsign PKCS11 ykcs11 unified kernel image
secure boot UKI sbverify yubikey PIV signing reject

subtopics.scope: Token identity readable before authentication (H10): PIV identity visible pre-auth so systemd-homed pkcs11-token-uri auto-selects the right username per inserted key.
seed_queries: systemd-homed pkcs11-token-uri auto login username
yubikey PIV certificate identity before authentication homed

subtopics.scope: Multi-key enrollment and revocation (H11): a second enrolled YubiKey unlocks the same resource, and wiping one slot leaves the other functional.
seed_queries: pamu2fcfg -n additional yubikey multiple keys pam
cryptsetup luksAddKey wipe slot revoke second yubikey

subtopics.scope: Suspend and resume key handling (H12): suspend=1 PAM entries forget key material so resume demands a fresh touch instead of a cached session.
seed_queries: pam u2f suspend resume reauthentication yubikey
systemd homed suspend fido2 reauth key material

subtopics.scope: Evidence capture and sequencing for the real-hardware run: what logs and artifacts each scenario must capture, and the B-VM-CTAP2-before-B-REAL-FIDO2 ordering with H8/H9 independence.
seed_queries: fido2 ctap2 software emulation testing vm libfido2
hardware security key validation evidence boot logs capture
